title: Quality gates for Phase 2: tests + build + lint evidence
Phase 3: Define storage schema versioning + migration strategy
acceptance_criteria: Storage format is explicitly versioned (either payload schemaVersion or new key) and documented in code/readme comment-free (types/consts are fine).
Load path handles missing/corrupt data by returning an empty list (no throw).
If an older schema is detected, data is migrated to the current in-memory shape and persisted back on next save (or immediately on load if chosen).

title: Phase 3: Add filter state + UI (All / Active / Completed)
acceptance_criteria: UI provides three deterministic filter states: All, Active, Completed.
Filter selection updates visible list correctly without mutating underlying data.
Filter control is keyboard accessible and has clear accessible names/labels.

title: Phase 3: Add items-left count (and optional total count)
acceptance_criteria: UI displays active-count (items left) that updates as todos are added/toggled/deleted/cleared.
Count remains correct after refresh (load from storage).

title: Phase 3: Implement 'Clear completed' bulk action (persisted)
acceptance_criteria: Clear completed removes only completed todos.
Result is persisted to local storage.
Control is keyboard accessible and has an accessible name.

title: Phase 3: Implement 'Toggle all' bulk action (persisted)
acceptance_criteria: Toggle all marks all active → completed; if all are completed, toggles all → active.
Result is persisted to local storage.
Control is keyboard accessible and has an accessible name.

title: Phase 3: Add automated tests for storage migration + corrupt/missing behavior
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover: missing storage → empty list; corrupt JSON → empty list (no crash).
Tests cover: older schema input → migrated current shape and persisted behavior (as designed).
Tests are runnable via `npm run test -w apps/todo-instance/frontend`.

title: Phase 3: Add automated UI tests for filters + bulk actions
acceptance_criteria: UI tests verify filter behavior (All/Active/Completed) changes visible items correctly.
UI tests verify: clear completed removes only completed items.
UI tests verify: toggle all toggles expected state (including the 'all completed' toggle-back case).

title: Phase 4: Refactor App.tsx into small components + todos.model helpers (no behavior change)

All existing tests remain passing with minimal/no snapshot churn.
`npm run lint -w apps/todo-instance/frontend` and `npm run test -w apps/todo-instance/frontend` pass.

title: Phase 4: Add accessible empty state when list is empty
acceptance_criteria: When there are 0 todos, UI shows a clear empty state message with accessible semantics.
Keyboard-first add flow remains intact (focus behavior not degraded).
Behavior persists across refresh (still local-only).

title: Phase 4: Inline edit todo title (Enter save / Escape cancel, trim, reject empty)
acceptance_criteria: User can enter edit mode for a todo title and modify it in-place.
Enter saves; Escape cancels and restores prior title.
Edits are trimmed; empty/whitespace-only edits are rejected (revert/no-op).
Edits persist via local storage and remain after refresh.

title: Phase 4: Add UI tests for empty state and inline edit keyboard flows
acceptance_criteria: UI tests cover empty state rendering when there are zero todos.
UI tests cover inline edit: Enter saves, Escape cancels, trimming behavior, and reject-empty behavior.
`npm run test -w apps/todo-instance/frontend` passes.

title: Phase 4 (optional): Undo delete (local-only, in-memory buffer acceptable)
acceptance_criteria: After deleting a todo, user can undo within a short time window (or until next action) without backend involvement.
Undo restores the deleted todo with its original id/title/done/createdAt fields.
If implemented, add at least one UI test covering undo flow.

title: Phase 5: Update todo spec to match current storage payload + add Phase 5 hardening section
description: Spec currently states storage is a JSON array; implementation uses a versioned payload. Update Storage rules accordingly and add a Phase 5 section describing forward-schema guardrail + phase convention consistency.
acceptance_criteria: `specs/todo-spec.md` Storage rules reflect versioned payload `{ schemaVersion, todos }` (not array-only).
Spec explicitly defines behavior for `schemaVersion > current` (forward version guardrail).
Add a Phase 5 section with scope + non-goals + verification approach (still local-only; no API/auth).

title: Phase 5: Add explicit guardrail for future storage schemaVersion (forward compat)
description: Make handling of `schemaVersion > TODOS_SCHEMA_VERSION` explicit and deterministic (no crash; no accidental overwrite).
acceptance_criteria: If persisted payload has `schemaVersion > TODOS_SCHEMA_VERSION`, load returns `[]` (or a clearly defined safe fallback) without throwing.
Forward-version payload does NOT get overwritten by an empty save during load (i.e., shouldPersist is false for forward versions).
Behavior is documented via code-level constants/types (no narration-only comments).

title: Phase 5: Add automated tests for forward-schema guardrail (schemaVersion > current)
description: Lock the forward-compat behavior with unit tests alongside existing storage tests.
acceptance_criteria: Test covers: payload with higher schemaVersion does not crash and results in safe behavior per spec.
Test covers: forward-version does not trigger persistence overwrite on load.
`npm run test -w apps/todo-instance/frontend` passes.

title: Phase 5: Tooling check to enforce numeric string `phase` convention in task queue
description: Prevent future drift like mixing "Phase 3" and "3" by adding/strengthening validation logic.
acceptance_criteria: Validation fails if `phase` is non-numeric (e.g. "Phase 3").
Error message points to task id(s) with invalid phase values.
Document how to run the validation (e.g. `npm run check` or a dedicated script) in an appropriate doc location.

List order is deterministic (newest-first by createdAt with a safe fallback).
Ordering remains stable after import and refresh.

title: Phase 6: Add automated tests for export/import + ordering

title: Phase 10: Add packages/db + Postgres migrations toolchain
description: Introduce Postgres and a single migrations toolchain with deterministic local + CI flows (migrate/reset/seed).
acceptance_criteria: packages/db exists with connection helpers and migration runner wiring.
Migrations are source-controlled and runnable from scratch in CI.
Local developer commands exist for migrate/reset/seed (names documented).

title: Phase 10: Create DB schema + migrations for tenants/users/memberships/todos
description: Add initial schema. Ensure tenant scoping is structural (FKs/constraints where applicable).
acceptance_criteria: Tables exist for tenants, users, memberships, todos with tenant_id enforced.
Unique constraint exists for (tenant_id, user_id) membership.
Migrations are rerunnable on a clean database.

title: Phase 10: Persist todo CRUD to Postgres (tenant-scoped)
description: Replace the persistence layer behind todo API with Postgres while preserving tenant isolation and deterministic behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Todo CRUD endpoints read/write Postgres (not local-only).
Tenant scoping remains enforced in queries/mutations.
Basic CRUD semantics remain consistent.

title: Phase 10: CI DB harness (migrations from scratch + tests)
description: Ensure CI spins up Postgres (or equivalent), runs migrations from scratch, then runs tests deterministically.
acceptance_criteria: CI runs migrations from scratch before tests.
Tests cover DB-backed CRUD + tenant isolation.
Quality can gate with deterministic commands and evidence.

title: Phase 9: Lock auth+tenancy contract (Tenant/User/Membership, roles, isolation rules)
description: Encode the agreed tenancy model and auth invariants as developer-executable constraints: Tenant/User/Membership(role), role set (owner/member), and the rule that all data access is tenant-scoped and membership-verified server-side.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant/User/Membership model and role set (owner/member) is recorded in repo docs/spec notes.
Tenant isolation rule is explicit: every todo is owned by tenantId; queries/mutations require membership verification.
API boundary expectation is explicit (todo CRUD via authenticated endpoints).

title: Phase 9: Add packages/auth skeleton (session cookie + guards)
description: Create shared auth primitives in packages/auth: session helpers, requireUser, requireTenantMembership, role checks. No secrets. No product-specific UI here.
acceptance_criteria: packages/auth exists with exported primitives for auth + tenant membership checks.
Session-based auth (httpOnly cookies) is the baseline mechanism.
Typecheck passes (`npm run check`).

title: Phase 9: Add server runtime baseline (cookie session capable) for /api/*
description: Introduce a minimal server runtime for apps/todo-instance so we can support cookie sessions and authenticated /api endpoints. This is a foundational step needed before CSRF mitigation and todo CRUD APIs can be implemented and tested deterministically.
acceptance_criteria: App has a server runtime that can serve an /api route and set/read httpOnly cookies.
Local dev flow is documented and runnable (command names only; no secrets).
`npm run check` passes.

title: Phase 9: Implement CSRF mitigation for cookie sessions
description: Add CSRF protection appropriate for cookie-based sessions for state-changing requests.
acceptance_criteria: State-changing endpoints are protected against CSRF (mechanism documented).
Unauthenticated/invalid CSRF requests fail deterministically.
No secrets committed; env var names only if needed.

title: Phase 9: Add login/logout flow and protected app shell
description: Implement minimal login/logout UX and block protected routes/actions when unauthenticated.
acceptance_criteria: User can log in and log out.
Unauthenticated users cannot access todo CRUD routes/actions.
Behavior is deterministic and testable.

title: Phase 9: Add tenant context selection (minimal)
description: Add minimal mechanism to establish current tenant context per user (e.g., default tenant or selection if multiple memberships).
acceptance_criteria: Current tenant context is deterministically established after login.
If multiple memberships exist, user can select a tenant (minimal UX acceptable).
Tenant id used for subsequent API calls.

title: Phase 9: Implement tenant-scoped todo API endpoints
description: Create authenticated endpoints for todo CRUD: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE. Enforce membership and tenant scoping server-side.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoints exist for GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE for todos.
Every operation is tenant-scoped and requires membership verification.
Cross-tenant access attempts are rejected deterministically (403/404 as designed).

title: Phase 9: Quality gates for auth + tenant isolation
description: Add tests proving tenant isolation and auth enforcement; produce Quality evidence output per schema.
acceptance_criteria: Automated tests cover: unauth blocked + two-tenant isolation (cannot read/write across).
`npm run check` passes.
Quality outputs pass/fail JSON with non-empty errors on fail.

title: Phase 9: Security review for auth + tenant isolation
description: Threat-model auth flows, cookie/session risks, CSRF, and tenant isolation boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Security notes list concrete risks + mitigations (session fixation, CSRF, tenant isolation).
Review confirms tenant isolation is enforced server-side.
No secrets included; pointers only.
